visual_action: Melania Trump is at a podium with the Presidential Seal. Text on screen reads "The way POTUS Looks at FLOTUS ❤️". Donald Trump enters the frame, clapping and smiling at her. He stands beside her, and they exchange smiles. They then hug and he kisses her on the cheek before they stand together at the podium. The video concludes with a sequence of black-and-white still photos of the White House and Marine One, with "THE WHITE HOUSE" text overlaid.
